no_zfill.note: Presented as dropping a redundant zfill on the entropy bit string; entropy with leading zero bits now yields a shorter bit string, so the words shift and the checksum bits are wrong (BIP39 vector 00000000... no longer encodes to 'abandon ... about').

skip_word_normalize.note: Presented as removing a per-word NFKD normalisation that 'split() input never needs'; words in composed (NFC) form, as typed on most keyboards for Spanish, French or Czech phrases, now fail with 'not in list' instead of decoding. Upstream tests only pass to_entropy NFKD words from to_mnemonic.

set_membership.note: Presented as making the exact-match test O(1) with a set; it builds a new 2048-element set on every call, which costs more than the linear list scan it replaces.
